design.owner_flow:
Where it happens: Casa is landlord.html (tab-tenants.js), Rentals is rentals-index.html (rentals-tab-tenants.js). rentals.html and index.html do not exist. Neither page loads controlling-data.js today.

Steps for the owner (same in both apps):
1. The tenant has moved out. Open the tenant. The Kaution card opens its move-out form by itself ("Settle"), as in K1.
2. RENT OWED: type the amount, e.g. 1.000. The month is already set to the last month of the rent window (Sep 2026); change it if needed. If two months are owed, tap "+ month" and fill in a second row (at most 3 rows).
3. DAMAGE:
   - Casa: in "Damage · receipt", pick the repair receipt you already paid in Maintenance › Schäden (Who pays › Schaden on this Zimmer). Its net amount (400,00) and its text fill in by themselves.
   - No receipt, or Rentals: type the amount and a Reason (e.g. "Wand gestrichen", "Endreinigung").
4. Anything else kept, e.g. an old NK Nachzahlung you settle in Settlements: "Kept · other reasons" + Reason, as today. The card books nothing for this row.
5. Tenants with an NK-Abrechnung: "Kept · for NK-Abrechnung", e.g. 300 (K1).
6. "Refund to tenant" is calculated (700). Transfer it by bank and type the transfer day in "Settled on" (also when the refund is 0).
7. Save. Nothing has to be entered anywhere else:
   - September shows as received in Controlling › Income.
   - The receipt says "Schaden · Lima · paid" in Maintenance, and Controlling counts +400 on that day.
   - The 300 € wait for the NK in Settlements (K1).
8. To change it later: Edit on the card, change or clear an amount, month, receipt or date, then Save. Controlling and Maintenance follow. Clearing "Settled on" takes every booking back.

Living tenants never see the new rows. A Kaution is not used during the tenancy.
design.form_layout:
Kaution card, move-out form (phase 4, and Edit of a settled card), one form from top to bottom, 2-column grid as in K1:

0. "Kaution Soll" (only in Edit, unchanged)
1. "Received" | "Received on". Prefilled as saved.
2. NEW "Rent owed" (money, empty, placeholder 0,00) | "Month" (native select: "Sep 2026", "Aug 2026", …).
   - The list runs from the month of the later of Move-out and Contract end (Rent until) back 12 months, never before the move-in.
   - Default: that latest month.
   - Under it a small text link "+ month", shown only once row 2 has an amount. It adds one more Rent owed | Month row (max 3).
3. NEW, Casa only, and only when this Zimmer has an open Schaden receipt: "Damage · receipt", a native select over the full width.
   - Options: "— none —" plus one line per receipt, e.g. "05.10.2026 · Maler Wand · 400,00 €".
   - Receipts listed: from Maintenance › Schäden, Casa (property 7), pay_type 'schaden', pay_rooms = exactly this one Zimmer, cost_date on or after Move-in.
   - Left out: receipts already paid directly (except the one this card picked), receipts in the Teil B snapshot of a locked NK year, and receipts shared by several Zimmer.
   - The list loads with the page's other data, so the row never pops in.
4. NEW "Damage" (money) | "Reason" (text).
   - With a receipt picked: read-only, showing its net (receipt − returns) and its description.
   - Otherwise typed. Rentals always types; Casa types when no receipt fits.
5. "Kept · other reasons" | "Reason". Calculated as before, and it follows the refund (K1 rule). The label is always "Kept · other reasons" in the move-out form.
6. "Kept · for NK-Abrechnung". Only for NK tenants, with the existing hint (K1).
7. Refund box: "Refund to tenant" | "Settled on". Refund = Received − Rent owed − Damage − Other − NK.
   - Typing Rent owed, Damage or NK recalculates whichever of Refund / Other you did not type last, as K1 does for NK.
8. Note line (existing; only parts above 0 are named): "2.400,00 € received − 1.000,00 € rent − 400,00 € damage − 300,00 € for NK".
   - Over-keeping shows the existing "Kept + refund can be at most …" and Save stays blocked.
9. Buttons: Cancel · Save (unchanged).

Settled read-only view: the same rows with their values. Rent owed shows "1.000,00 €" | "Sep 2026". Damage shows "400,00 €" | "Receipt 05.10.2026 · Maler Wand". Caption: "Settled on 15.10.2026 · 300,00 € held for NK" (K1).

No new toasts, warnings or hints. A failed write uses the existing "Not saved" (ccSaveFailed).
design.data_writes:
Save on the Kaution card. Every booking is a state that can be set again without harm, so re-saving or a double tap never doubles. Bookings exist only while the card is settled (Settled on filled, or everything kept after move-out). They are dated "Settled on", except the rent row, which is by rent month.

Order: one ccQueueWrite chain per tenant. On any failure: "Not saved", the form stays open with what you typed, and the next Save repeats it safely.

A. RENT OWED → Controlling ctrl_income_months, row (unit of the Zimmer / flat / parking, 2026, 9). New controlling-data.js helper ctlIncomeKauSet(unit_id, y, m, tid, a, nk):
   - It reads the stored row from the database, not from memory.
   - It changes only this tenant's Kaution part:
     - split[tid] = max(0, split[tid] − kau_part[tid].a) + a
     - nebenkosten = old − kau_part[tid].nk + nk
     - kaltmiete = total − NK
     - kau_part[tid] = {a, nk}
   - It writes through the existing ctlUpsertIncome (same payload, onConflict unit_id,year,month, plus the new optional `extra` = {kau_part}). It clears the "On purpose" mark when the total changes. When nothing is left, it calls ctlDeleteIncome, so the month is "missing" again.
   - The month is booked once; a re-save with the same values writes nothing. A transfer typed in Controlling for the same month, or another tenant's part in a change month, stays untouched (prototype cases in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Casa-Castel/73a72b00-f7fb-5b02-be13-e1f6fde2dd3e/scratchpad/rt/k1b/design/kau-rent-math.js).
   - Month changed: the old month gets a = 0, the new month a.
   - tid = the tenant record id, the same key Controlling uses.
   - nk = a × NK / rent of that tenant in that month. It uses _tnCurrentRent / _rntCurrentRent at the month, which follow the same rule as Controlling. For Pauschal it uses "davon NK" of the rent entry (can be 0), like Controlling's _cxIncNkShare.
   - The unit comes from ctrl_units and ctrl_properties, read at Save, by ctlUnitLink's rules:
     - casa_room by room id, then by name. A Casa room without a unit gets one through ctlCreateUnit, exactly like Income.
     - rentals_apartment by apartment id, then the property whose rentals_apartment_ref is the flat and that has a single living unit.
     - rentals_parking by parking id, then by name.
     - Nothing found → "Not saved".

B. DAMAGE, Casa receipt picked → maint_costs update {pay_via:'direct', pay_paid_on: settled_at}. The existing D39 trigger maint_book_line then:
   - books ONE "Erstattung Mieter" income line in ctrl_expense_one_time (+net, dated paid_on, maint_refund_of = the receipt, kind Sonstiges);
   - takes the receipt out of Teil B.
   The card stores the receipt's previous pay_via / pay_paid_on (kept.dmg.was) so it can restore them.
   Maintenance returns (return_of) are NOT used. They are shop returns (Rückgabe slips) that lower the receipt's net in Teil A/B and in the 'mit/ohne Rückgaben' PDFs. "Direct · Paid on" is the existing record of a tenant paying a receipt.

C. DAMAGE without a receipt (and always in Rentals) → one ctrl_expense_one_time line, written with the existing ctlAddOneTime / ctlUpdateOneTime / ctlDeleteOneTime:
   - found first by source_ref 'kau:<app>:<kaution id>';
   - {property_id: 7, or the flat's / parking's Controlling property; invoice_date: settled_at; item 'Kaution einbehalten · Schaden · <Reason>'; amount; company: tenant name; kind 'Sonstiges'; direction 1; nk_umlage false}.

D. Kaution row (kaution / rnt_kaution), written last:
   - existing fields: received, returned, nk_einbehalt, deduction_reason, settled, settled_at;
   - new `kept` jsonb, e.g. {"rent":[{"m":"2026-09","a":1000}],"dmg":{"a":400,"r":"Maler Wand","cost":"<uuid>|null","was":{"v":"nk","p":null}}}.

"Kept · other reasons", the NK hold, the refund and the Kaution itself write nothing to Controlling (R1, K1).
design.controlling_effect:
Example. Lena, room Lima (Casa; Rentals works the same):
- Kaution 2.400 € received 02.01.2023.
- Moved out 30.09.2026. September rent 1.000 € (800 Kalt + 200 NK) unpaid.
- Repair: Maler 400 €, a Maintenance › Schäden receipt dated and paid by you 05.10.2026, Who pays › Schaden · Lima (via NK).
- Card saved: Rent owed 1.000 Sep 2026, Damage = that receipt (400), Kept for NK 300, Refund 700, Settled on 15.10.2026.

Controlling afterwards:
- Income › Sep 2026 › Lima: Soll 1.000, Ist 1.000 (Kalt 800 / NK 200, split {Lena: 1.000}). Before: "missing 1.000". Dashboard and export September +1.000 (rent month, spec option A).
- One-off, October 2026:
  - Maler −400 (05.10., already there);
  - new "Erstattung Mieter · Lima" +400 (15.10.);
  - the receipt line now reads "Tenants pay · Schaden — Lima · paid direct 15.10. · −400,00 €".
  - October net effect of the damage: 0 (the repair cost is carried by the tenant, R5).
- Kaution 2.400 in, 700 out, 300 held: 0 € everywhere (R1).
- Total of the move-out for 2026: +1.000 instead of −400 before K1b.
- Rentals variant: the receipt stays as it is (−400 on 05.10.) and the card adds "Kaution einbehalten · Schaden · Wand gestrichen" +400 on 15.10. Same totals.

Later changes:
- Edit to 600: Sep Ist 600 (NK 120). With a 400 transfer typed in Controlling: 1.000.
- Clear: Sep "missing" again.
- Move the date to 20.10.: the +400 moves to 20.10.
- Unpick the receipt: the +400 goes, and the receipt is "via NK" again.
design.settlements_effect:
Nothing changes in the Settlements code. It already reads ctrl_income_months:
- Casa: scVzMonths, row.nebenkosten per room-month.
- Rentals: ctlSettlementFigures nkIst, the NK share of the tenant's Ist.
D39 Teil B already skips Direct receipts.

Example, NK 2026 letter for Lena: NK costs Jan–Sep 2.050 €.
- VZ: Jan–Aug 1.600 + Sep 200 (now booked as paid) = 1.800 → Nachzahlung 250.
- The 300 € kept on the card are offset (K1) → "You pay back 50,00 €" → Controlling +250 on the payback day (K1 C11).
- Teil B: the Maler 400 € receipt is Direct, so it is NOT billed again.

Without K1b:
- VZ 1.600 → Nachzahlung 450, so Sept NK is charged twice → "Lena transfers 150,00 €".
- Teil B2 adds the 400 € a second time.

Limits:
- A letter that was already sent or locked keeps its frozen figures. Settle the Kaution before the final NK letter; this is also the K1 order, because the hold goes to the first letter sent after settling.
- Pauschal, Kurzzeit Pauschal and parking: no NK-Abrechnung, so the NK part only splits the Controlling row.
design.undo_and_edit:
Edit on the card reopens the same form with the saved values (kept jsonb). Save makes Controlling and Maintenance match the form. Each step only sets a state, so it can run twice.

- Rent amount changed (1.000 → 600): that month's Kaution part is replaced. Ist 1.000 → 600, NK 200 → 120. A bank transfer for the same month typed in Controlling stays (400 + 600 = 1.000).
- Rent cleared: the part is removed. If nothing else is in that month, the row is deleted and the month shows "missing" again. The next tenant's part in a change month is never touched.
- Month changed (Sep → Aug): taken out of September and put into August in the same Save.
- Second month added or removed: handled the same way.
- Receipt changed or unpicked: the old receipt's pay_via / pay_paid_on go back to what they were before the pick (kept.dmg.was), and the D39 trigger removes its "Erstattung Mieter" line. If it was "via NK", it is billed in Teil B again. A newly picked receipt is set to Direct with "Settled on".
- Typed damage changed: the same Controlling line (source_ref 'kau:<app>:<kaution id>') is updated. Cleared or 0: deleted.
- "Settled on" moved: the receipt's paid-on date and the damage line date move. The rent row is by month and stays.
- "Settled on" cleared (back to "Settle", nothing verrechnet yet): every booking is taken back (rent part 0, receipt restored, line deleted). It comes back on the next settling Save.
- Re-save without changes, or a double tap: no Controlling or Maintenance write at all (kau_part already equals the value, the receipt is already Direct, the line is already the same).
- Changed by hand elsewhere:
  - Sept typed as 0 in Controlling: it stays 0 on a re-save with the same card values.
  - Who pays changed in Maintenance: a later card Save sets it again.
- Old cards settled before K1b (kept is null): nothing is booked until you type into the new rows. "Kept · other reasons" never books, so nothing you entered by hand under the K1 answer (Q1 A) is doubled.
- Deleting the tenant: the Kaution row goes. The kept rent and damage stay in Controlling, because they were real money.

design.risks:
1. Unit match. The tenant pages copy ctlUnitLink's rules. If they ever differ, the rent lands on another unit: September stays "missing" and a stray row appears. Mitigation: explicit links first ("Apply suggestions" in Setup, and CONTROLLING-ROOM-IDS.sql already linked the Casa rooms); "Not saved" when nothing is found; a parity test against ctlUnitLink for every tenant.
2. Two-step save. The Controlling writes and the Kaution row are separate requests. This is safe only because every booking is a state that can be written again (kau_part, receipt Direct + date, source_ref). The order is bookings first, Kaution last.
3. Controlling open in another tab with old data in memory. Typing in that same month before the page reloads can overwrite the split (kau_part survives). C5 reloads the year when the app comes back. Low risk.
4. NK letter already sent or locked for the kept month. It stays frozen, and the tenant was charged that month's NK in it. Settle the Kaution before the final NK letter (the K1 order).
5. A receipt can only be paid in full (D39 Direct = full net). To keep only part of it, type the damage without a receipt and set that receipt to "You pay" in Maintenance; otherwise Teil B bills it. Receipts shared by several Zimmer are not offered.
6. A receipt changed later in Maintenance (Who pays) or a line changed in Controlling: the card still shows its own values, and the next card Save sets them again.
7. A receipt whose "Book in Controlling" switch is off: D39 books no refund line. That is consistent, because the cost is not in Controlling either.
8. An old month row without a split in a month with two tenants: "Not saved". Rare: rows from before the Oct 2026 per-tenant Ist.
9. September in the Dashboard changes afterwards, because rent is booked by rent month. The damage counts on "Settled on".
10. Loading controlling-data.js into the tenant pages:
    - Its cache tag must be bumped in 4 html files.
    - On the tenant page, ctlUpsertIncome's own fallback when the On-purpose columns are missing would crash (window._ctrl.diff is null there), so the helper calls ctlDiffProbe first.
11. Data access. The Casa page now writes maint_costs and ctrl_* with the same landlord login; cc-nk-settle.js already writes ctrl_settlements from these pages, so this is an existing pattern. Still check RLS once on the live database.
12. Old cards: "Kept · other reasons" never books. An owner who puts cleaning there sees nothing counted. The label of row 4 and the Reason make "Damage" the natural place for cleaning.
13. Form length on the iPhone: 7 rows in the move-out form. Native selects only, no new sheet, no row that appears while typing ("+ month" is tapped).

design.simpler_alternative:
The part that costs the most is the Casa receipt picker:
- loading receipts, returns and locked years;
- the D39 write with restore of the earlier Who pays;
- the filtering rules.
That is about 4–5 h of the 17.5 h.

Simplest acceptable version, about 11 h:
1. RENT OWED: as designed, but one month only (no "+ month"), and the unit only through Controlling's explicit link ("Not saved" otherwise). It still needs KAUTION-K1B.sql (kept + kau_part); without it, edit and undo cannot be done safely.
2. DAMAGE: in both apps, "Damage" amount + Reason → ONE Controlling income line (source_ref 'kau:<app>:<kaution id>', dated "Settled on"). No receipt picker and no Maintenance writes. Rule for Casa: leave that repair receipt on "You pay" in Maintenance. The −400 receipt and the +400 line then net to 0 in Controlling.
   - Cost of this version: if the receipt was already set to Who pays › Schaden via NK, Teil B bills it a second time. The full design prevents that by setting the picked receipt to Direct · paid.

Not acceptable as an alternative:
- Typing the month in Controlling by hand (the second entry the owner rejected).
- A version without SQL (it would double on re-save and could not be undone).

review.verdict: Approve with changes. The rent part is correct, and every claim about it checks out against the code. kau_part on the ctrl_income_months row makes the booking exactly-once and reversible. Booking by rent month is how Controlling books every late rent. Using the tenant's id as the split key matches ctlIstFor and _cxTenancies (w.id = String(t.id)). Controlling's own saves keep kau_part, because their upsert payloads never contain it. Kept rent counts as rent paid and its NK part as NK prepayment, which is correct in law. The Casa damage-receipt part (step B) has to be redone. It depends on receipts set to "Who pays › Schaden · <Zimmer>", and Maintenance refuses to save that for a repair dated after the move-out while the Zimmer is empty (maintenance.js:2010-2011, mtWhoProblem 'vacant'). If the next tenant already lives there, such a receipt is billed to the next tenant in Teil B. A receipt that can carry the tag is a damage from during the tenancy, and the NK letter (Teil B) plus the K1 NK hold already charge it. Fix: the damage becomes one income line written by the card, in both apps. The receipt picker only fills in the amount and the reason, and nothing is written to Maintenance. Also drop controlling-data.js from the tenant pages, add a reconcile step so a failed Save cannot leave a stray booking, and fix the Edit maths on a settled card, the '+ month' link that appears while typing, and the wrong 'connection problem' text. Realistic effort: about 17 h.
problems: CRITICAL, damage receipt (Casa): the receipt the design picks cannot normally exist. Maintenance refuses to save Who pays › Schaden on a Zimmer nobody rents on the receipt date. The receipt pop-up's Save says 'Lima is vacant on 05.10.2026 – change Who pays or the date.' (maintenance.js:2010-2011). The Who pays sheet blocks Save with 'vacant' (mtWhoProblem, :3627-3635) and never preselects an empty Zimmer (mtWhoOrt :3616-3622). So the design's own example cannot be set up in Maintenance: Maler on 05.10 after the move-out on 30.09. The K1 spec's step 5 ('works in Casa today') is wrong for the same reason. If the next tenant already lives in Lima, such a receipt is charged to the NEXT tenant, because Teil B bills whoever lives in the Zimmer on the receipt date (scTeilB, settlements-tab-casa.js ~423). When the card writes pay_via 'direct' straight into maint_costs, it bypasses these checks. Maintenance then shows the tag in its error style ('Lima vacant that day', mtWhoTag :3544), and any later Save of that receipt in Maintenance fails.

Wrong claim: 'Without K1b Teil B2 adds the 400 € a second time.' Teil B goes by the receipt date. A receipt dated after the move-out is never in the leaving tenant's letter. A Schaden-via-NK receipt from during the tenancy is billed in her NK letter, and the K1 NK hold covers it. Offering it on the card as well is exactly what would charge it twice, so it must not be offered.

Partly wrong claim about the NK effect. In Casa, scVzMonths counts a missing month of a finished year at the contract NK, marked '1 month(s) from the contract' (settlements-tab-casa.js:226-231). Without K1b, Lena's 2026 letter (made in 2027) would still show a Nachzahlung of 250, not 450. September is charged twice only while the year is still running or in a preview. In Rentals the claim is true: ctlSettlementFigures skips the missing month (controlling-soll.js:1661) and vz = nkIst (settlements-tab-rentals.js:358-361). So the benefit is real, but the Casa example overstates it.

The copied unit-matching rules are incomplete compared with ctlUnitLink / _ctlPropLinks (controlling-soll.js:310-375). Missing: (a) the automatic flat link by property name = apartment name when rentals_apartment_ref is empty; (b) a unit with an explicit but broken source_type/ref gets NO automatic match; (c) the parking match needs _cxIsParking(u), i.e. garage / stellplatz / tg in unit_type or name, and matches '<property name> <unit name>'; (d) Casa matches the tenant's room by name (_cxTenancies matches t.room by name, not by id). Any gap books the rent on another unit: September stays 'missing' and a stray row appears.

Loading controlling-data.js into landlord.html and rentals-index.html is not needed and is not 'idle'. Its MutationObserver watches the whole page and runs on every change of the tenant page (controlling-data.js:532-543). ctlUpsertIncome looks up the old row in memory, which is empty on those pages (:262-268). Adding `extra` to its signature forces cache-tag bumps in controlling.html and settlements.html. Writing the three tables directly with sbL takes about 60 lines and leaves Controlling's files alone.

A stray booking can stay forever. Bookings are written before the Kaution row. If that last write fails and the owner taps Cancel, `kept` stays old (or null). The next Save then only reconciles the months in keptOld ∪ keptNew, so the September kau_part / split part is never taken back. Every Save should also reconcile the rows that already hold kau_part for this tenant (read: kau_part not null, then filter by key).

Edit of a settled card gives the wrong refund. At Edit, ui.typed is null, so _cckForm recalculates the refund (fromRefund false → rf = Received − …) when Rent owed or Damage is typed, although the refund has already been transferred. On an old card with 1.350 'other' and a 1.050 refund, typing Rent 1.000 makes the refund 50. On a settled card the refund must be treated as typed (ui.typed = 'ref'), so 'Kept · other reasons' absorbs the change and over-keeping is still blocked.

The '+ month' link appears once row 2 has an amount, i.e. it pops in while the owner types. That contradicts the design's own 'no layout shift while typing' rule. Either show it always in the move-out form until there are 3 rows, or never. Two rows with the same month must be added together before booking.

'Not saved' for a unit that is not linked goes through ccSaveFailed, whose text is 'Not saved — connection problem. Your previous values are back, please try again.' (direct-save.js:51). That is wrong: it is not a connection problem, and the typed values are not reset. The owner counts wrong text as a real bug. Give one exact line that names the unit and Controlling › Setup.

'Clearing Settled on takes every booking back' is not true when the refund is 0. keptAll settles again on Save with today's date (cc-kaution-card.js keptAll → settled_at today) and moves the damage line to today. Taking bookings back means clearing the amounts.

ccKauProbe adds 3 extra requests on every page start. That is not needed: the kaution rows are already loaded with select('*'), so the `kept` key shows whether the SQL ran (the same trick _cckHasExtra uses for received_at). kau_part only needs checking at Save. Loading the receipt list with the page data adds Maintenance reads to every start of the tenant page, for a form that is rarely used.

Minor: for a Pauschal tenancy with no rent entry, _tnCurrentRent gives NK 0, while Controlling's _cxRentDay uses the old NK value (controlling-soll.js:763-776). Settlements also uses 0. Keep 0; it only changes the Kalt/NK split shown in Controlling.

Minor wording: the line text 'Kaution einbehalten · Schaden · …' reads as if the Kaution itself is counted, which clashes with R1. Use D39's wording 'Erstattung Mieter · <Reason> · aus Kaution'. In the settled read-only view, empty Rent owed / Damage rows add two '—' rows to every settled card; show them only when they have a value.

Two small corrections: the claimed crash in ctlUpsertIncome's fallback only happens when diff_ok is in the payload, which needs ctlDiffOn('inc'). Controlling open on another device: the read-modify-write is not atomic, and a stale Controlling tab can drop Lena's split part while kau_part stays. A re-save of the card then writes nothing. This is rare, because C5 reloads Controlling when its tab becomes visible again; accept it and document it.
review.improved_design:
PRINCIPLE: the Kaution card is the only place to enter it. It writes three things, each a state that can be written again safely. (1) This tenant's part of a rent month in ctrl_income_months (kau_part). (2) One damage income line in ctrl_expense_one_time, found by source_ref. (3) The Kaution row with `kept`. Nothing is written to Maintenance, Settlements or Controlling's own files. "Kept · other reasons", "Kept · for NK-Abrechnung", the refund and the Kaution itself book nothing (R1, as in K1).

PREREQUISITE: build on part T (wt-k1t) after C9 and the check fix "keptAll only when movedOut".

OWNER FLOW (both apps, same steps):
1. The tenant has moved out. Open the tenant; the Kaution card opens its move-out form by itself (K1).
2. RENT OWED: type the amount. The month is preset to the last month of the rent window. Use "+ month" for a second or third month (tenants who use up the Kaution by not paying the last rents).
3. DAMAGE: type the amount and a Reason. Optional "From receipt": a native list of the repair receipts from Maintenance › Schäden for this Zimmer (Casa) or this flat's property (Rentals). Picking one fills Damage with its net (receipt − returns) and Reason with "<text> · <date>". Both stay editable, e.g. to keep only part of it.
4. "Kept · other reasons" + Reason (not counted: things you settle elsewhere, e.g. an old NK letter you mark Received in Settlements). Plus "Kept · for NK-Abrechnung" (K1).
5. "Refund to tenant" is calculated. Pay it by bank and fill "Settled on". Save.
Result: September counts as received in Controlling › Income. October gets "Erstattung Mieter · Maler Wand · aus Kaution" +400 on the Settled-on day, which offsets the −400 receipt in Controlling (the tenant carries the cost, R5). The NK hold waits for Settlements (K1).

FORM (move-out form and Edit of a moved-out tenant; 2-column grid as in K1):
0. Kaution Soll (Edit only).
1. Received | Received on.
2. Rent owed | Month. Native select: the later of Move-out and Contract end back 12 months, never before the move-in; default = the latest. Under it, a small "+ month" link that is ALWAYS shown in this form until there are 3 rows (nothing appears while typing). Rows with the same month are added together on Save.
3. "From receipt" (full width, native select, "— none —" first). Shown only when the list is not empty. The list loads once, when a moved-out tenant's card is first drawn, together with that tenant's data, and before the form shows. It is not loaded at page start.
   Receipts listed: Maintenance › Schäden (maint_cases.kind 'schaden'); Casa: report_room = this Zimmer (matched by normalised name); Rentals: case.property_id = the unit's property. Only receipts with Who pays empty ("You pay"); cost_date from Move-in to today; net > 0; not already picked by another Kaution card.
   Not listed: receipts that are already NK / Kleinreparatur / Schaden. Tenants pay those through Teil B or directly, and listing them would charge them twice.
4. Damage | Reason.
5. Kept · other reasons | Reason (label always this in the move-out form).
6. Kept · for NK-Abrechnung (only NK tenants, K1 hint).
7. Refund to tenant | Settled on. Refund = Received − Rent − Damage − Other − NK. Rent and Damage count like NK in the K1 "typed" rule.
   NEW: on a settled card the refund counts as typed when Edit opens, so changes go into "Other" and the money already paid out stays.
8. Note: "2.400,00 € received − 1.000,00 € rent − 400,00 € damage − 300,00 € for NK" (only parts above 0 are named). Over-keeping shows the existing "Kept + refund can be at most …" and blocks Save.
Read-only (settled) view: Rent owed "1.000,00 € | Sep 2026" and Damage "400,00 € | Maler Wand · 05.10.2026", shown only when they have a value. Caption as K1.
Living tenants and databases where the SQL has not run (no `kept` key on the kaution rows): the new rows are not shown, and K1 works byte-for-byte as before.

DATA WRITES (cc-kaution-book.js; direct sbL calls; the whole Save runs in ONE ccQueueWrite chain per tenant: saveAmounts → bookings → Kaution row):
Bookings exist only while the card is settled (Settled on filled, or keptAll after the move-out).
A. Rent. Unit: read ctrl_units + ctrl_properties at Save. Match exactly by ctlUnitLink's rules, ported in full:
   - explicit source first (casa_room by id, then by name; rentals_apartment; rentals_parking); an explicit but broken link → no unit;
   - otherwise parking by _cxIsParking + name / '<property> <unit>';
   - Casa (prop 7) by unit name;
   - flats through the property's rentals_apartment_ref, or by property name = apartment name, with a single living unit;
   - the tenant's room is matched by NAME (as _cxTenancies does).
   A Casa room without a unit gets one exactly like _cxIncUnit / ctlCreateUnit: name, 'Zimmer', casa_room, source_ref = room id, sort_order = max + 1, and the same retry when the id is taken.
   No unit: the form stays open. Show one exact line: "Not saved — <unit> is not linked in Controlling › Setup". Do not use ccSaveFailed, whose text says "connection problem".
   For each month, read the row from the database and set this tenant's part as in kau-rent-math.js:
   - split[tid] = max(0, split[tid] − kau_part[tid].a) + a
   - nebenkosten = old − kau_part[tid].nk + nk (capped at the total); kaltmiete = total − NK
   - kau_part[tid] = {a, nk}
   - nk = a × NK / total of the rent on that month (_tnCurrentRent / _rntCurrentRent). For Pauschal: "davon NK" of the rent entry (period.nebenkosten, may be 0; no entry → 0).
   - Upsert onConflict (unit_id, year, month). When the total changes and the row has diff_ok, also write diff_ok = false, diff_reason = null (only if the row has those keys). Delete the row when the split is empty. Write nothing when kau_part already equals the new value.
   - An old row without split: used only when no other tenant of the unit lived there that month; otherwise "Not saved" with the same exact line.
   RECONCILE (new): every Save also reads the rows where kau_part is not null, keeps those holding this tenant's key, and sets a = 0 for every month no longer on the card. A Save that failed between the bookings and the Kaution row then heals itself.
B. Damage: one line in ctrl_expense_one_time, looked up by source_ref 'kau:<tn|rnt>:<kaution id>'.
   - Fields: property_id = the unit's property (Casa 7); invoice_date = Settled on; item '<Zimmer/flat> · Erstattung Mieter · <Reason> · aus Kaution'; amount; company = tenant name; kind 'Sonstiges'; direction 1; nk_umlage false; source_ref.
   - Insert, update or delete (amount 0, or not settled). Rentals and Casa work the same.
   - No maint_costs write, no D39 trigger, no `was` to restore, no question of a locked year.
C. Kaution row last: the existing fields + kept = {"rent":[{"m":"2026-09","a":1000}],"dmg":{"a":400,"r":"Maler Wand · 05.10.2026","cost":"<maint_costs id or null>"}}. The cost id is only a reference, used to hide that receipt from other cards.
Any failure: the existing toast; the form stays open with what was typed; the next Save repeats everything safely.

CONTROLLING EFFECT (Lena, Lima, 2.400 received; Sep 1.000 owed (800 + 200 NK); Maler 400 paid 05.10 "You pay"; 300 held for NK; refund 700; settled 15.10):
- Income Sep: Soll 1.000, Ist 1.000 (K 800 / NK 200, split {Lena 1000}, kau_part).
- One-off Oct: Maler −400 (05.10, unchanged); "Erstattung Mieter · Maler Wand · aus Kaution" +400 (15.10). Net effect of the damage in October: 0.
- Kaution 2.400 in, 700 out, 300 held: 0 everywhere (R1).
- 2026: +1.000 instead of −400. Rentals is the same.
- Edit to 600: Sep Ist 600 (NK 120); a 400 bank transfer typed in Controlling stays (Ist 1.000).
- Clear the amounts: September is 'missing' again and the line is deleted.
- Move Settled on: the line moves; the rent stays in its month.
- Refund 0: keptAll settles on Save. To take bookings back, clear the amounts.

SETTLEMENTS: no code change.
- Rentals: September's NK now counts in nkIst, so Sept NK is no longer charged a second time in the letter.
- Casa: the month reads 'paid' / 'per Controlling' instead of '1 month from the contract'. The figures change only for letters made while the year is still running.
- Teil B is untouched, because only "You pay" receipts are offered.
- Letters already sent or locked stay frozen: settle the Kaution before the final NK letter (the K1 order).

FILES:
- NEW KAUTION-K1B.sql (unchanged draft: kaution.kept, rnt_kaution.kept, ctrl_income_months.kau_part, notify, check).
- NEW cc-kaution-book.js: unit match, rent set + reconcile, damage line, receipt list.
- cc-kaution-card.js: rows, draft keys (rent rows, month, receipt, damage, reason), _cckForm sums, settled-Edit refund rule, note, read-only rows, Save → book → Kaution row.
- tab-tenants.js / rentals-tab-tenants.js adapters: rentAt, unitRef (room name / apartment_id / parking_id), months (rent window), receipts filter (Casa report_room / Rentals property).
- landlord.html / rentals-index.html: add cc-kaution-book.js and bump the 3 changed files.
- NO change to controlling-*.js, settlements-*.js, maintenance.js, MAINTENANCE-D39.sql, controlling.html, settlements.html.

TESTS (K1 harness, mocked Supabase):
- T1 rent booked (row, kau_part, Income received, Rentals nkIst Sep).
- T2 re-save / double tap: zero writes.
- T3 edit / clear / Sep→Aug.
- T4 bank transfer + card.
- T5 change month: next tenant untouched.
- T6 Pauschal with "davon NK" 0 and >0; 2–3 months; same month twice.
- T7 unit for flat / parking / Gewerbe / property-name link / broken explicit link / Casa room without a unit.
- T8 parity: the cc-kaution-book unit = the real ctlUnitLink (controlling-soll.js loaded in node) for every tenant in the data.
- T9 damage line: insert / edit / date move / clear; receipt picker: what is offered and what is not (tagged, other Zimmer, before move-in, picked by another card).
- T10 failure injection: Kaution write fails, then Cancel, then a later Save reconciles the stray kau_part.
- T11 settled Edit: the refund stays, "Other" absorbs the change.
- T12 old card (kept null): nothing booked.
- T13 living tenant / SQL not run: K1 unchanged.
- T14 the 'not linked' text.
- Regression: reg-ctl 54/54, Settlements regress, tenants regress, K1 repros (p1–p4, r1–r6, t1–t6, check-t attacks, k1r-money).
- iPhone 390 px: Casa with and without receipts, Rentals flat, parking, settled view; no layout shift while typing.

HOURS: build 10 (SQL + html 0.5; cc-kaution-book.js 4; card 4.5; adapters 1); tests + regression + screenshots 4.5; independent check + one fix round 2.5. Total about 17 h. Without the "From receipt" list: about 15 h. Without "+ month" as well: about 13.5 h. In that case the owner types several months' rent as one amount on the last month, and the months before stay 'missing' in Controlling, which is not recommended.
